title: MCP servers in Settings: list, add, test, remove
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's and Codex's capabilities; the UI review's next gap.
plan: the person's servers in config.json, checked
in every new session beside DCLab's
a test that asks an http server for its tools
a sheet section to add, test and remove

decisions.decision: The settings log names the servers only
decisions.why: an address may carry a key in its query

decisions.decision: No password in an address; the name dclab is DCLab's
decisions.why: a credential never in the config's address; DCLab's server is never replaced

change: dclab-code server/config.js (cleanMcpServers), server/app.js (settings and mcp-test), server/engine.js (the session's servers), web (the sheet's MCP section), tests, docs.

findings.defect: Enter in a server field would save the whole sheet
findings.scenario: typing an address and pressing Enter
findings.cause: the sheet's Enter saved from any input
findings.fix: Enter in the server fields adds the server

outcome: The person manages their own MCP servers in the app.
lessons: Log a setting's name, not its value, when the value can hold a secret.
risks: a stdio server is tested only when a session starts
